description: System definition for watch intent modes. Declares the principle that tracking is intent-driven, not entity-type-driven.

content.purpose: Replace fixed entity-type staleness rules (vessel=6h, aircraft=2h, etc.) with intent-driven track segmentation. The same entity can have different watch intents in different cases, and the segmenter respects all active intents simultaneously.
content.principle: Tracking is a function of WHY we care, not WHAT we are tracking. A flight number watched for one specific day has bounded segmentation. The same flight number watched indefinitely has persistent segmentation. The same flight number watched only when crossing a border has conditional segmentation. Same entity, three different track shapes.
content.scope: Watch intents live on case_observables, watch_topics, and monitoring thread filters. They are never properties of the entity itself.
content.default_behavior: When no watch intent references an entity, a default 'passive' track is maintained with a 24-hour idle gap. This exists so that if a watch is created later, history is available to backfill.
